text:
anya (docs): Pushed a small PR that consolidates quota/rate examples, SDK snippets, and a grafana link. draft: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/2899 :wave:

sam (eng-platform): Thanks! Quick Q: are the examples hourly or per-minute aggregates? billing prefers hourly so we should be explicit.

anya (docs): I included both and labeled them: hourly as canonical (billing) + 1m moving avg for ops.

mike (product): Use hourly as primary. Add a one-line explanation: "Visible allocation = committed tier + burst credits; billing reconciles on daily UTC windows."

lia (devex): Heads-up: update the header name to X-RW-Usage (legacy X-Usage-Tokens mapping note would help). Also add a tiny JS snippet for parsing body.series[].points.

anya (docs): Will do. Current curl examples I'll add show both group_by values:

```
# hourly (billing)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-RW-Usage: project=acme,env=prod" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/usage?from=-1h&group_by=1h"

# per-minute (ops)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-RW-Usage: project=acme,env=prod" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/usage?from=-1h&group_by=1m"
```

sam (eng-platform): Add Grafana panel permalink (panel id 42) and a troubleshooting note: if totals double during canary->stable flips, check routing headers and unique meter_key per route.

lia (devex): Example JS snippet (minimal):

```
// hourly aggregation
const res = await fetch('/v1/usage?from=-1h&group_by=1h', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`, 'X-RW-Usage': 'project=acme' }});
const body = await res.json();
console.log(body.series[0].points.map(p => p.value));
```

anya (docs): Adding header rename, legacy mapping note, Grafana panel id, hourly + 1m snippets, JS example, and a small callout that fallback routing can shift per-model attribution. Pushed edits.
